::: {.lede}
I think software counts as research output. These are the R packages I've written or contributed to, most of them built to answer a question in my research.
More on [GitHub](https://github.com/janithwanni).

## Author

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
### kumquat

A simpler, transparent LIME for tabular data. It exposes the perturbations, the black-box predictions and the local GLM, so you can see how each explanation is built.

[CRAN]{.badge} [Explainable AI]{.badge}

[Docs](https://janithwanni.github.io/kumquat/) ·
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=kumquat) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/janithwanni/kumquat)
:::

::: {.card}
### kultarr

Anchors written in pure R. You can inspect it and debug it, it runs in parallel and caches its search, and it can draw anchors in high-dimensional tours.

[In development]{.badge} [Explainable AI]{.badge}

[Docs](https://janithwanni.github.io/kultarr/) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/janithwanni/kultarr)
:::

::: {.card}
### scatteR

Generates scatterplots with given scagnostic features, using simulated annealing. Presented at useR! 2022.

[CRAN]{.badge} [Data generation]{.badge}

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=scatteR) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/janithwanni/scatteR) ·
[Preprint](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2209.06682)
:::

::: {.card}
### sillysplines

An htmlwidget (Svelte front end) for drawing a linear-spline decision boundary and exporting it as a synthetic classification dataset.

[In development]{.badge} [Teaching]{.badge}

[Docs](https://janithwanni.github.io/sillysplines/) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/janithwanni/sillysplines)
:::

## Contributor

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
### DSjobtracker

A data package of the skills and qualifications asked for in data science job ads worldwide. I curated and cleaned the 2021 data as a consultant at the Statistical Consultancy Service, University of Sri Jayewardenepura.

[CRAN]{.badge} [Data]{.badge}

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=DSjobtracker) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/thiyangt/DSjobtracker)
:::

::: {.card}
### nic

Nature Inspired Colour palettes from Sri Lankan flora and fauna. I photographed the sources, quantised the images and built colour-blind-friendly palettes.

[CRAN]{.badge} [Visualisation]{.badge}

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=nic) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/thiyangt/nic)
:::

::: {.card}
### tsdataleaks

Detects data leakage between series in forecasting competitions. I sped up its core calculations with Rcpp.

[CRAN]{.badge} [Time series]{.badge}

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=tsdataleaks) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/thiyangt/tsdataleaks)
:::

:::

## Apps & tools

- **[Bird watcher](https://janithwanni.shinyapps.io/abuja-bird-watcher/)**: a Shiny and leaflet app for exploring bird-watching sites in Nigeria with GBIF data, built for the Abuja useR group.
- **Netball data entry**: a real-time Shiny app backed by Azure SQL for the Sri Lankan national netball team (Sports Analytics Unit, University of Sri Jayewardenepura).
- **Shiny dashboards for life-sciences clients** at [Appsilon](https://www.appsilon.com), plus engineering support for their R packages.
